summary: Full backend + frontend test of Gyro Compass Repeater. Backend: 6/6 pytest tests pass (health endpoint, WS ~10Hz stream, NMEA malformed/bad-checksum robustness, custom valid $HEHDT updates heading). Frontend: all data-testid elements present, LIVE status green, digital heading (257.3°) updates every second, NMEA feed shows $HEHDT sentence, bearing sight click sets RB~90° when clicking east, R key resets RB to 000.0°, B key hides/shows the bearing line & TB/RB readouts, settings dialog displays UDP 4001 / SIMULATOR / ws URL and apply closes the dialog. Compass card rotates so heading value aligns with lubber line (visual check confirmed).
critical_code_review_comments: useHeadingStream.js: `connect` callback closes over stale `getWsUrl()` via localStorage — works but `wsUrl` state dependency is only used to re-trigger useEffect; fine.
CompassRose.jsx angleFromEvent computes atan2 twice (readability) — minor.
Simulator loop uses random.random()<0.01 (~10% chance each 100ms) to change rate — fine; heading drift confirmed live.
No auth on WebSocket / health — acceptable for this MVP display.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_gyro_repeater.py. UDP NMEA robustness tests must run from inside the container (sends to 127.0.0.1:4001). Simulator is authoritative every 100ms so custom $HEHDT sentences are transient — the test bursts 30 sends and polls /api/health looking for 123.4.
